children: The US dollar has lost about 97% of its purchasing power since the Federal Reserve was created in 1913, with a 1913 dollar worth roughly 3 cents of today’s goods, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI-U. Bitcoin was designed as a scarce alternative to that system, and as of early September 2026 it trades near $79,852, below its October 2025 peak of $126,080, according to BeInCrypto, while spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn $55.62 billion in cumulative net inflows and hold $101.25 billion in assets.

title: US Dollar Has Lost 97% Of Purchasing Power Since 1913, Bitcoin Gains Spotlight
